# Agentify (Agentic Commerce Gateway)

> Monorepo that turns any ecommerce backend into an agent-native merchant:
> Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) discovery, MCP tools, agents.md, llms.txt,
> cart/checkout with buyer approval, Razorpay test-mode payment and audit.

Read [docs/index.md](docs/index.md) first, then follow links only when you need
detail. Human README: [README.md](README.md).

## Getting started

- Install deps: `pnpm install`
- Run all tests: `pnpm test`
- Typecheck: `pnpm typecheck`
- Build packages (ESM + types): `pnpm build`
- Demos: `pnpm demo`, `pnpm demo:second`, `pnpm demo:razorpay`
- Start gateway: `pnpm gateway`

## Source map

- [packages/canonical-commerce](packages/canonical-commerce/): canonical model, CommerceProvider contract, capability detection
- [packages/adapter-rest](packages/adapter-rest/): config-driven REST adapter + fixture second merchant
- [packages/adapter-mock](packages/adapter-mock/): demo merchant (SQLite)
- [packages/mcp](packages/mcp/): capability-gated MCP server (Streamable HTTP)
- [packages/ucp](packages/ucp/): UCP business discovery profile
- [packages/metadata](packages/metadata/): agents.md + llms.txt generators
- [packages/payments](packages/payments/): payment orchestration + audit
- [packages/payments-razorpay](packages/payments-razorpay/): Razorpay gateway + offline fake
- [packages/middleware](packages/middleware/): Express/Hono/Node mounts
- [packages/cli](packages/cli/): `agentify init/generate/serve`
- [apps/gateway](apps/gateway/): composer (`createGateway`) + server
